title: crouton-result
description: One crouton-alpha docs/UX result for one sealed capability. Closed shape: additional properties are rejected at every object level.
$comment: Paths in written_paths are relative to the repo root and must sit under backend/docs/** intersected with capability.scope. A UX behaviour is never asserted here without evidence: surfaces that could not be read or observed belong in unverified, and documented mismatches belong in ux_gaps. REFUSED means no path was written; BLOCKED names the rejected path or the unread surface.

tree.description: Git tree sha of the working tree after the writes; must match the capability end-state tree.

written_paths.description: Every doc path written or edited, each with the sha256 of the final bytes. Empty when nothing was written: REFUSED, or BLOCKED before the first write.

ux_gaps.description: Documented mismatches between docs/design notes and implemented behaviour, each with its evidence ref. Not silently fixed in prose.

unverified.description: User-visible surfaces that were not read or observed. A behaviour listed here is not claimed as done.

status.description: DONE = docs written in scope; BLOCKED = a needed path or surface fell outside backend/docs/** or capability.scope; REFUSED = invalid envelope or moved state.

evidence_ref.description: path:line, path:line-line, or a tool-result id backing the result; never a bare assertion.

path.description: Repo-relative path under backend/docs/**; must also be inside capability.scope.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the final file bytes.
